name: Hotel Alpin
beschreibung: The Hotel Alpin in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser is located close to the Brandstadlbahn. The surroundings in the Kaisergebirge offer access to the slopes of SkiWelt in winter and to hiking and cycling trails in summer. The hotel's rooms are decorated in Tiroler Landhausstil. The wellness area includes a sauna and a steam bath. In the restaurant, regional cuisine is served. Guests can book half board at the hotel.
